topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: Well, now, isn’t this a fine day! The sun’s out, and there’s a light breeze that whispers through the wheat, promising a good season. And here, you got flowers too, just like that, from no one in particular. Must be the Saints playing a kind game, or maybe it’s someone from the village, shy as a rabbit in spring, not wanting to show their face. Whoever it was, they’ve a good eye for such things. Red and gold, they match the sun at set, don’t they? You should put them in a vase by your hearth. A bit of color in the house always makes the nights warmer, and the days a bit brighter. It’s the little things, they say.
